PARTIAL_FIX_TRAPS: Pointing DATABASES['default'] at the intended writer without fencing/epoch demotion still leaves double-writable shop files.
Fixing ShopdeskRouter alone while AZ_WRITE_AFFINITY still diverts AZ-B mutations to replica leaves split placement.
Making /healthz green or forcing /readyz 200 without writer-count/seq-gap/pins/repeat-capture gates admits unsafe traffic.
Moving sticky keys without a shared pins store still loses read-your-writes across boxes after session wipe.
Idempotent pay path without unique capture effect per attempt_id still double-fires webhooks.
sync_standby that copies a writable fence lease recreates double-primary on standby.
Aligning heal_plan dump checks without making /readyz consume the same live_ready predicates leaves traffic acceptance lying.
role_output.REMOVAL_TEST: Removing ~25% of the load-bearing core (router+fencing+sessions+lag, checkout place/pay, fulfill capture, desk_state/heal_plan/readiness composition, replica sync) would collapse the claimed HA/checkout behaviors and operator commands. Separately, removing the residual never-referenced helper bodies (~350–410 LOC) and the single discard-touch line would not materially change current starter outcomes—small residual padding, not system-defining scale.
